name: topic
label: Topic
help: What the post is about, up to 200 characters: the news, the offer, who it is for.

name: platforms
label: Platforms
help: Up to four platforms. One post is written for each.

name: brand_id
label: Brand
help: The brand whose voice to use. Left empty, Skryvo uses the account's default brand.

name: pictures
label: Pictures
help: Designs a picture in the brand's kept look with each post, using image credits. Takes about a minute.

name: tone
label: Tone
help: For example friendly or professional. Left empty, the brand's tone.

name: language
label: Language
help: A language code such as en or de.

name: link
label: Link
help: A web page the post points to.

name: confirmed
label: Confirmed
help: On, the posts are written now. Off, the module returns the settings, cost and balance and writes nothing.
